  PROBLEM: The `log_tail` gate checks the `short()`-processed `summary` instead of the raw Checks API summary, so whitespace-only or newline-only summaries can skip `fetch_log_tail()`.
  WHY: `short()` replaces newlines with `" | "`, making an effectively empty summary look non-empty after `.strip()` and defeating the intended fallback for empty Check Run summaries.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2049-2056 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `CHECK_RUNS_LOG_TAIL_BYTES` is clamped only at the low end, so a misconfigured very large value can make `fetch_log_tail()` buffer far more log data than intended in memory.
  WHY: `subprocess.run(..., capture_output=True)` reads the full job log before slicing, so an unbounded configured cap can drive excessive memory use or OOM failures.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2075-2090 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `fetch_log_tail()` captures the full `gh run view --log` output into memory before applying the byte limit.
  WHY: Large logs inflate peak memory usage unnecessarily, which can slow or destabilize the workflow even when the final tail is small.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2085-2098 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `fetch_log_tail()` only catches `TimeoutExpired`, `OSError`, and `ValueError`, leaving other subprocess/decode failures uncaught.
  WHY: An uncaught exception aborts the Python heredoc instead of failing open with an empty `log_tail`, which can drop check-run context for that iteration.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2044-2065 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: fetch_log_tail docstring + surrounding comment (lines ~2044-2065 and 2118-2122) + README.md row for CHECK_RUNS_LOG_TAIL_BYTES still claim the log tail is fetched for failed check-runs (or reference the prior unconditional path); implementation now gates strictly on empty `summary`.
  WHY: No direct crash, but operators and future reviewers cannot rely on the documented contract, leading to incorrect expectations about snapshot content and extra API calls.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
